test_groupby_agg_with_numba_engine: test groupby aggregation using numba engine instead of cython for custom aggregation functions
test_numba_function_signature_validation: test that numba aggregation functions require exactly two positional parameters (values, index) and raise NumbaUtilError on incorrect signatures
test_numba_kwargs_handling: test that numba aggregation functions reject keyword-only arguments and properly bind positional arguments passed to agg
test_numba_vs_cython_results: test that numba engine produces identical results to cython engine for standard reductions like mean, sum, min, max
test_numba_jit_compilation: test that pre-jitted numba functions and plain functions both work correctly with groupby aggregation engine
test_numba_cache_behavior: test that multiple different numba functions are cached correctly and reused when called again with the same function
test_numba_parallel_execution: test that numba engine supports parallel=True and nogil=True engine_kwargs for parallel aggregation execution
test_numba_global_config_override: test that compute.use_numba global config option enables numba engine when engine is set to None
test_numba_skipna_handling: test that numba engine respects skipna=False parameter and propagates it correctly for aggregation functions
test_numba_udf_custom_aggregation: test that user-defined numba aggregation functions like values.sum() and values.min() produce correct results
test_numba_args_not_cached: test that positional arguments passed to numba aggregation functions are not cached and re-evaluated per call
test_numba_engine_kwargs_not_cached: test that different engine_kwargs values produce separate jitted functions instead of returning cached results
test_numba_index_passed_correctly: test that the index array is correctly passed as the second parameter to numba aggregation functions
test_numba_multiindex_grouping_not_suppo: test that numba engine raises NotImplementedError when grouping by more than one label
test_numba_multilabel_groupby: test that numba engine works correctly with multi-label groupby on multiple columns
